items: One automation spine: APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Workflows that recover from failure on their own — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.

At Technology & SaaS level this capability reads as: runbooks, incident summaries and PR reviews automated with policy (engineering hours reallocated to product). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery runs on one weekly rhythm for every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.
